text:
Seven pieces of sushi on a dinner plate: a thick slice of tuna (about 30 g, ~35 kcal), two spicy roll pieces with cucumber (~30 g each), two pieces topped with masago (~30 g each), and two California roll pieces with sesame (~30 g each). The six roll pieces come to about 180 g at roughly 1.5 kcal/g, or about 270 kcal. Adding the tuna gives about 210 g and 305 kcal in total.
